reviews.t: Excellent Product with Outstanding Customer Service
reviews.x: I have ordered a handful of products from Amazon, and I may have written a review or two, but I am compelled to write a review for this wonderful company.  First of all, the product arrived early and was exactly what it stated it would be on Amazon.  I had done hours of research on Retinol creams in order to select one I thought would be best without getting it from a dermatologist.  This company provides an all natural (mostly organic) product with the highest amount of retinol available OTC.

I am 49 years young. I have been using this cream for about a month now. Twice a day. Small amounts. I can not believe how fast this works. My deep wrinkles on my forehead and expecially between my eyebrows above my nose, have almost disappeared. I ordered another bottle to make sure I never run out.

I spent daily time in the sun and got sunburn.  I have VERY fair skin and developed a tan and freckles (which is basically sun spots, yuck!)  Worst of all I had a new wrinkle on my forehead!  So  I got this stuff hoping it would reverse it...  Not only did my sunspots go away,  everything else did!  My skin looks so clear - EVEN MY ACNE went away!  And acne scars!!  The darkness under my eyes cleared up!  I looove this stuff and put it on every night!  And I am a peace knowing it is mostly organ

I am REALLY noticing a difference with this product.  I use it every night, and I have found that gently massaging the Retinol Cream into my face and problem areas on my face,  also helps. The deep congestion that I have been struggling with forever, is clearing.  The other positive aspect of this product is that it does not cause my skin to be drawn and dry.  I am so happy that I finally found this product!!
I've been using this for a few weeks and definitely see a difference. Plus it is ORGANIC and there is no irritation.

Hi, to update my previous review, I just purchased my 2nd bottle of the Key West 2.5% Retinol Night Repair. If miracles could come true, one did for me while using this product. Since my last review, my wrinkles have gone from pretty much faded, to many of them completely gone! I volunteer for kindergarten, and the teacher I helped last yr thought I had a face lift during the summer. Lol. That compliment was one of the nicest I've ever received. This is a white cream, so you know where to put it

I have been reading about how important retinol is for older skin, so I began researching the different brands/prices.  I decided on this one for the price, retinol strength and reviews.  I am not disappointed.  I have noticed a difference in the texture of my skin on my face and neck.  It is softer, the years of sun damage/age spots are fading.  I am a true believer.  At 54 years of age, I am very careful of the products i choose to use, and this will be one of the permanent ones for my skin ca

reviews.t: I've used this product for a good 12 weeks
reviews.x: I was not overly impressed. I've used this product for a good 12 weeks.  I do believe my pores are smaller; fine lines?  I would say they are not reduced.  This was not at all irritating to my dry skin; and I still needed to use moisturizer when using.  I used this every single night for 12 weeks. The product does not stink or smell and goes on very nicely.  I just don't notice much of an effect on my skin.

I have been using this cream consistently at night for about a month. ( I write the date on the bottom of my products to keep track of when I started. It helps me to decide whether to buy them again or not ).  My skin looks good, feels smooth, and I've been complimented on my complexion several times. I just ordered some of this for my friends birthday. I also wear Josie Maran sunscreen every day. I'm 51.
The 2.5% they must be referring to is 2.5% of the cream is like .0005% strength Retinol.  This is crap.

reviews.t: Squint lines virtually disappeared in two weeks
reviews.x: I am 45 years old with chronic acne (worse than as a teen) and very, very oily skin.  I would never, ever consider using a moisturizer.  Ever.  I purchased this product to see if it would help clear up my acne.  I have been using it regularly for 2 weeks and in that short time have seen great improvement in my skin.  Not miraculous as I still have had blemishes, but certainly remarkably improved.  I have not experienced any redness at all, nor any flakiness even though I have been using it twice

Unfortunately I must say that the product did not work. i have been using the cream two time a day as per instruction (which are not very clear on how to applay the cream on the spots to cure) and I have seen any change or at least a shadow of the spots. Disappointed expecially because is very expensive for the quantity. Sorry to say but it has been a complete failure. My spots are still there!!!!

I bought this retinol mid May '15 for $21.95. I finally an ran out of the 1.7 oz. bottle so I came back to order another once since I really like the retinol cream; it lasts a long time & it really does work. Good product, but not the $$. Can't justify the $16.00 price increase to $38.00.  I will find another retinol & not do business with Key West Health & Beauty.

reviews.t: I HAVE SENSITIVE SKIN AND THIS WORKS!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.x: You can honestly tell the moment you put this retinol cream on your face, that there is a quality, a good amount of retinol in this product.  It does not make my skin  red, even though I do have sensitive skin.  I like the way it feels on my skin and what my face looks like the next morning.  I have never had that with any other retinol face product before.  One in particular which I had spent a lot of money on, did nothing for me.  So, I would highly recommend this product. Even family members and friends have commented about how great I look. My favorite was when my mom told me I look well rested! I believe this product has really helped clear up some of the discoloration issues that I suffer from and lessened some of the wrinkles that I have started to notice popping up here a

reviews.t: My face looks and feels great!
reviews.x: I researched other Retinol products and decided to try this one.  I am amazed at the difference it makes and how great it feels when I put it on my face.  This product lasts a long time.  It only takes a small amount, and it feels luxurious on my face.  I honestly look forward to putting it on at night.  It has lasted at least one month, and I'm still using it.  I am placing a second order today to ensure that I never run out!  My facer is looking great!

Very nice creamy texture goes on well and leaves a nice finish to the touch. I would say that it is nice addition to the various skin care products I already use . The 4 star rating is only because I've only been using it a short time but will be purchasing again . Feels like a high end cream but at an affordable price point.
I have used vitamin C creams with some success, but this has shown no difference what so ever.

This retinol cream is really great.  I have used other face creams in the past and while effective I found them to be more expensive than this one and I needed to use a lot more.  I have been using this product once a day for about a week and I can already notice a difference.  I really like the smell, not a heavy perfume but almost a "scentless" smell.  I only need a pump, maybe a pump and a half if my face is dry that day to do the job.  The cream isn't super thick like a heavy lotion

Although the cream came very well packaged and delivered on time I am very disapointed in the cream . I have found no difference in mY skin at all . I have used other retinol creams and always experienced a slight burning . So you know the retinol is working . But not with this . I done my research as well and this one had the best reveiws . I feel as though I have wasted my money . I will go back to using my other cheaper retinol cream . And have better results .

Amazing product! You will love the results. My skin is smoother than ever and so clear. I also love the company. They really care about your results and check up on you, offer tips and are quick to respond to questions about the lotion. Since using this product, I have gotten so many compliments on my skin :) Try it! You won't be disappointed!

I have bought many retinol creams before but this product has not worked at all. I know how to use a retinol product to and have seen many estheticians in my lifetime, so warning....this product is not good for anything. I'll have to get in my car, drive to my esthetician's office and buy the product I know works for $58 dollars!

claims.text: Many reviewers report visible improvements in wrinkles, fine lines, and skin texture after using the product.
Several reviewers praise the product for being organic and non-irritating, even on sensitive or dry skin.
A few reviewers report the product did not work for them or produced no noticeable results.
Some reviewers question the product's efficacy due to its clear container, arguing retinol cannot survive light exposure.
Some reviewers mention the product helped clear acne and congestion.
